text:
ashley: CI turned red on main after I merged the constraints refresh. failing on ubuntu-py310-integration, redis session tests time out only on CI. stack shows 'ConnectionResetError' in redis-pool

kevin: ugh. do we know which package changed in the lock? any transitive bumps?

ashley: i ran `poetry lock --no-update` locally and diffed the lockfile. didn't expect changes but `poetry lock` without --no-update picked up a new httpcore 0.18.x (was 0.17.x). weird because we pinned constraints file.

ryan: can you paste the failing test log snippet? also what was the exact commit that regenerated the lock?

ashley: log: ```
E   ConnectionResetError: None
...
redis.client    | ConnectionPool: releasing connection that is closed
```
commit is `b7f3a2c` — that was the constraints refresh from yesterday.

sara: @ashley can you try `poetry lock --no-update` and then `poetry export -f requirements.txt --without-hashes -o /tmp/reqs.txt` and run our ubuntu container locally `./ci/run_in_container.sh /tmp/reqs.txt pytest tests/integration/test_sessions.py::test_cookie_sessions -q` to reproduce? if it fails locally it's easier.

ashley: reproduces locally inside the container, same timeout. i also tried `pip install -r /tmp/reqs.txt` on mac and it passed — so this might be linux wheel/platform difference.

ci-bot: CI job 3421 failed: "ubuntu-py310-integration" — flaky? rerun with same inputs? (use `/rebuild` in the thread)

kevin: let's not rerun yet. we need to bisect whether the lock regen introduced an incompatible transitive pin. ashley, can you `git checkout b7f3a2c~1` and run the same container + test, then checkout `b7f3a2c` and run again? if the failure appears only after b7f3a2c then it's likely the lock/constraints change.

ashley: running now.

devx-bot: FYI: there is an open constraints CI job that runs nightly and updates `constraints.txt` at 02:00 UTC.

ashley: result: on `b7f3a2c~1` test passes. on `b7f3a2c` fails. so it's reproducible and probably the lock change.

ryan: ok good bisect. next step: can you run `poetry lock --no-update -vv` at `b7f3a2c` and save `poetry.lock` plus a `pip freeze` from the container to see exact installed versions? also check `pip debug --verbose` to inspect wheel/platform resolution.

ashley: uploaded the artifacts to the build logs: /tmp/ci-artifacts/2411112222/ — includes `poetry.lock`, `reqs.txt`, `pip-freeze.txt`. main suspect: httpcore and/or urllib3 wheel resolution.

kevin: I can take a look. if it's httpcore bump we could pin it back in constraints and re-run CI quickly. but we should confirm no other regressions.

sara: if pinning fixes CI, we should add a short note to the constraints refresh PR to explain why we held back that transitive dep and open an upstream issue.

ashley: agree. can someone trigger the quick rerun if kevin posts a pinned constraints diff? (/rebuild after patch)

kevin: i'll try a temporary pin to `httpcore==0.17.2` in the constraints and push a tiny commit. if CI goes green i'll open a followup to track the upstream.

ashley: thanks — ping me when you push and i'll re-run the failing job. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Command acknowledged: rebuild queued for job 3421 (awaiting patch).

kevin: pushed `fix/constraints-temporary-pin` -> `origin`. patch is just constraints pin + lock regen.

ashley: rerun queued, watching.

devx-bot: rebuild finished: job 3421 — SUCCESS (with temporary pin)

kevin: looks like pin fixed it. i'll open an issue on upstream and mark the constraints refresh PR with the rollback note.

ashley: great, i'll merge the temporary pin to unblock main then we can iterate on a proper fix. thanks everyone.
